# E0342: a lens drops a field its target version requires

A drop says a source field has no place in the target. Where the target
requires a field of that name, dropping it would leave a required field absent.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
	b: int
}

ForwardLens: (prev): {
	self: {
		a: _drop
		b: 1
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
	b: int
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0342]: v1.0 requires a; dropping it would leave it absent
 --> history/1.0.thema:8:3
  |
8 |         a: _drop
  |         ^
  |
```
